016package org.vafer.jdeb.producers;
017
018import java.io.File;
019import java.io.FileInputStream;
020import java.io.IOException;
021import org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarArchiveEntry;
022import org.vafer.jdeb.DataConsumer;
023import org.vafer.jdeb.DataProducer;
024import org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.Mapper;
025
026/**
027 * DataProducer representing a single file
028 * For cross-platform permissions and ownerships you probably want to use a Mapper, too.
029 */
030public final class DataProducerFile
031  extends AbstractDataProducer
032  implements DataProducer
033{
034
035  private final File file;
036
037  private final String destinationName;
038
039  public DataProducerFile(
040    final File pFile,
041    String pDestinationName,
042    String[] pIncludes,
043    String[] pExcludes,
044    Mapper[] pMapper
045  ) {
046    super(pIncludes, pExcludes, pMapper);
047    file = pFile;
048    destinationName = pDestinationName;
049  }
050
051  public void produce(final DataConsumer pReceiver) throws IOException {
052    String fileName;
053    if (destinationName != null && destinationName.trim().length() > 0) {
054      fileName = destinationName.trim();
055    } else {
056      fileName = file.getName();
057    }
058
059    TarArchiveEntry entry = Producers.defaultFileEntryWithName(fileName);
060
061    entry = map(entry);
062
063    entry.setSize(file.length());
064
065    Producers.produceInputStreamWithEntry(
066      pReceiver,
067      new FileInputStream(file),
068      entry
069    );
070  }
071}
